lines: Aahat si koi aaye to lagta hai ke tum ho
couplets.en: At the faintest footfall, I think it is you.

lines: Aahat si koi aaye to lagta hai ke tum ho
couplets.en: At the faintest footfall, I think it is you.

lines: Jab shaakh koi haath lagaate hi chaman mein
couplets.en: In the garden, a branch feels the touch of a hand.

lines: Sharmaaye lachak jaaye to lagta hai ke tum ho
couplets.en: It bends so shyly, I think it is you.

lines: Aahat si koi aaye to lagta hai ke tum ho
couplets.en: At the faintest footfall, I think it is you.

lines: Sandal se mahakti hui purkaif hawa ka
couplets.en: The soft air is fragrant with sandalwood.

lines: Jhonka koi takraaye to lagta hai ke tum ho
couplets.en: When a breath of it brushes against me, I think it is you.

lines: Saaya koi lehraaye to lagta hai ke tum ho
couplets.en: When a shadow stirs, I think it is you.
